issue_request: FHIR-15748 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core metadatatypes change request asking that DataRequirement valueSetReference use canonical(ValueSet), not Reference(ValueSet); its resolution said to change valueSetReference to valueSetCanonical.

No prior FHIR-15748 reconciliation commit was present on the combined branch before this audit.
additional_context: DataRequirement is current build-scope source through active source/fhir.ini datatype/metadatatypes/normative entries. Later Published/Persuasive FHIR-16055 was applied in SVN 13847 / git commit 4cd5fe67cd712a5cf12329da39bf088a20b03275 and collapsed the valueSet[x] choice to a single valueSet element of type canonical(ValueSet), explaining why the current element is named valueSet rather than valueSetCanonical.
